name: image-skills
tagline_zh: 让 Claude 帮你搞创作：image-skills。英文简介见下。
desc_en: Six agent skills for image work — direction, prompt, generate, refine, review, deliver. The pixels come from Codex's imagegen; this is the discipline around it, and every generated file carries the recipe that produced it.

install.note: clone 下来，挑你要的那件复制进 ~/.claude/skills/。这是一个合集，没有「装它」这个动作。
